Hi Stephanie / Laura —

Thanks for the sync last week. I attached the latest Aurora_MAP_v2.xlsx with comments from procurement and infra. Quick summary:
- Procurement has signed off on commercial terms pending final SLA attachment.
- Security wants the SOC 2 evidence and a list of retention/audit log settings for the Private deployment evaluation.
- Infra needs a hard date to snapshot their test environment; they asked for a "lock" on the sprint lane by EoF Friday so they can schedule the evaluation run (we're targeting a full-load eval next week).

As the buyer, I need a short owner list, decision on the SLA attachment, and confirmation that the evaluation plan (end-to-end runbook + metrics) will be available to Aurora's DevOps by Thursday.

Can Redwood commit to:
1) Delivery of the evaluation runbook (doc + short checklist) by Thu 26 Mar 2027 EOD?
2) Provide SOC 2 evidence and retention settings reference by Thu?
3) Lock the feature set for the evaluation (no upgrades) by Fri 26 Mar 2027?

We're flexible on exact times but the timeline matters for our procurement window.

Thanks — happy to jump in a quick 15 if helpful.

Cara Simmons
Director of Platform Integrations
Aurora Health

Cara — thanks, got the workbook and the questions. I've pulled the asks into a short decision log below and assigned owners. Please treat this as our working MAP checkpoint for this week; I added explicit due dates so Aurora can plan.

Decision log / Action items (current sprint)
1) Evaluation runbook (runbook + checklist) — Owner: priyom_das — Due: 2027-03-25 (Thu) EOD
   - Deliverable: runbook doc link + one-page checklist for infra. Priyom to include smoke tests and KV-cache warmup steps.
2) SOC 2 evidence & retention settings guide — Owner: laura_bennett — Due: 2027-03-25 (Thu) EOD
   - Deliverable: SOC 2 summary + KMS/HSM integration note + retention/audit log table.
3) Sprint lane lock (feature freeze for evaluation) — Owner: marcus_lin (eng lead) — Due: 2027-03-26 (Fri) 17:00 PT
   - Decision: only hotfixes for critical bugs allowed after lock; no model/quantization profile changes.
4) SLA attachment (commercial) — Owner: stephanie_nguyen — Due: 2027-03-25 (Thu) 12:00 PT
   - Deliverable: attach SaaS-SLA-draft.pdf; include uptime/latency SLOs and a short exceptions list.

Notes / constraints:
- Infra wants a machine-readable list of endpoints and auth scopes for the evaluation cluster by Thu morning. Priyom will provide a Postman collection + curl snippets.
- If SOC 2 evidence is delayed, propose a scoped evaluation that excludes customer-data exports.

Quick schedule:
- Thu 25 Mar: runbook + SOC2 doc delivered
- Fri 26 Mar 17:00 PT: sprint lane locked
- Mon 29 Mar: evaluation run (Aurora infra + Redwood test harness)

Agenda for follow-up (Thu 25 Mar, 11:00 PT — 30m):
- Confirm runbook contents (Priyom)
- SOC2 evidence walk-through (Laura)
- Finalize SLA attachment (Stephanie)

If that looks right I'll update the MAP workbook and post links. I attached the draft SLA for your legal/procurement review (SaaS-SLA-draft.pdf).
